issues.title: Shared navigation label still says "Investors relations"
issues.summary: The shared Company navigation module still renders the label "Investors Investors relations, reports and filings," leaving a grammar error in a repeated sitewide navigation element.
issues.recommended_action: Update the shared label to "Investor Relations" and verify the corrected copy anywhere the Company navigation module appears.

issues.title: Primary contact form is still not observable in the current capture
issues.summary: The page still asks visitors to share their goals, but the current review capture does not expose any form fields, labels, or submit control for the main conversion form.
issues.recommended_action: Verify in a full browser pass that the form renders reliably and exposes labeled inputs and a submit action.

issues.title: Press release cards still append stray "view" text
issues.summary: Multiple press release links still end with an extra trailing word, such as "...Agentic Automation view," which makes the listing headlines read like broken card copy.
issues.recommended_action: Separate the card CTA label from the headline text or remove the stray trailing "view" string from the listing template.

issues.title: Featured resource cards still rely on generic "See more" CTAs
issues.summary: Multiple promoted resources continue to use the same vague CTA label, "See more," which weakens scanability and makes the destination type unclear before click-through.
issues.recommended_action: Replace the repeated CTA with destination-specific labels such as "Read the report," "Open guide," or "Watch the webinar."

issues.title: Blog filter controls still collapse into a hard-to-read text block in capture
issues.summary: The blog filter controls still appear as one long uninterrupted string, including "2009#NiCETalks," which suggests the filter pattern may be collapsing into an unreadable block in at least one rendering mode.
issues.affected_element: Blog year and topic filter controls
issues.recommended_action: Verify the filter controls in a full browser session and adjust the layout or accessible text structure if the controls are collapsing visually or semantically.

issues.title: Section heading still reads as a grammatical error
issues.summary: The integrations page still includes the heading "Security share data," which reads as a broken phrase and does not match the surrounding clear, benefit-led headings.
issues.recommended_action: Replace the heading with the intended phrasing, such as "Securely share data," and verify the corrected section title in the live layout.

issues.title: Hero copy still misspells "preferable" as "preferrable"
issues.summary: The product hero still reads "Personal, preferrable, AI-powered connections," leaving a spelling error in a prominent conversion area.
issues.recommended_action: Correct the word to "preferable" and recheck the hero copy on desktop and mobile.

issues.title: Agenda section still shows repeated stray time labels
issues.summary: The agenda timeline continues to repeat the standalone time string "9:00 am – 10:15 am" before multiple agenda cards, which makes the schedule harder to scan and suggests duplicated label output.
issues.recommended_action: Remove the duplicate time labels from the agenda card pattern and confirm the schedule cards render once per session with a single time stamp.

issues.title: Sponsor logo links still appear without readable link labels
issues.summary: The sponsors section still exposes multiple outbound links as blank linked elements with URLs only, which suggests logo-only links without dependable accessible names.
issues.recommended_action: Give each sponsor logo link a readable accessible name through alt text, visible text, or aria-label and verify the result with linearized navigation.

run_warnings: The live repository still does not expose the expected operational config, rules, brand guidance, accessibility guidance, feedback controls, or template files through GitHub contents reads. This run used /workspace/agent_files/repo-starter as the fallback reference for URLs, QA rules, severity guidance, brand guidance, accessibility guidance, CTA guidance, performance guidance, and summary templates.

Live prior report history was available and used for comparison, but no live approved-fixes, rejected-findings, reviewer-feedback, approved-exceptions, or known-false-positive control files were present in the repository during this run.

Prior repository history is inconsistent across the 2026-05-13 through 2026-05-15 artifacts, so recurring classification was favored over regression claims unless the repository contained an explicit resolved state.

Coverage was partial for visual, interaction, accessibility, and performance review. Inspection was limited to current page text/html capture without screenshot validation, click-through traversal, form submission, or assistive-technology testing.
